cross_product_finding: Cross-product reuse confirmed: search:create-type-mapping was already minted for server/search/create-type-mapping.md (server/7.2), and that extraction flagged a notable_absence for requiresPrivilege ('no role/privilege stated for creating/editing a type mapping'). This cloud/ page has the exact same gap for RBAC, but for a different reason: instead of an RBAC privilege, the prerequisite list ('You have logged in to the Couchbase Capella UI', 'You have the Search Service enabled on a node in your operational cluster') implies access is gated by being an authenticated Capella UI session with appropriate organization/project/cluster access, not by a named privilege. The Capella procedure is also framed around a breadcrumb navigation hierarchy (organization -> project -> cluster) absent from the server/ version of this task, reinforcing that Capella's access model is organization/project-scoped rather than privilege-scoped.

notable_absence.finding: Like the server/ version of this page, this Capella page never states which organization or project role a user needs to create or edit a type mapping - only 'You have logged in to the Couchbase Capella UI' is given as a prerequisite.
